description: This file defines template classes for plugin monitoring and interface management within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for monitoring plugin activation/deactivation, managing interface pointers, and handling communication channels between plugins and controllers. The code facilitates dynamic plugin interaction, interface acquisition, and lifecycle management, primarily for plugin-based architectures.

classes.name: PluginHost::PluginMonitorType
classes.description: Template class for monitoring plugin activation and deactivation, managing interface pointers, and notifying handlers.

classes.name: RPC::SmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing the lifecycle and communication with a plugin interface exposed via RPC, handling activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: RPC::PluginSmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for plugin-side management of plugin interfaces, including registration, lifecycle handling, and interface access.

classes.name: RPC::SmartControllerInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing controller interface connections, including opening, closing, and interface querying.

methods.name: IsOperational
methods.description: Checks if the plugin or interface is operational.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the callsign for plugin monitoring.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin or interface with the monitoring system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin or interface from the monitoring system.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a specific interface from the plugin or controller.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Callback for derived classes to handle operational state changes.
